claims.behavior_proved: PostgreSQL-backed opaque hashed sessions enforce 30-minute idle and 12-hour absolute lifetimes, login rotation, logout of current session, all-session revocation on forced password change, CSRF synchronizer tokens and exact Origin checks. Forced-change sessions can access only the approved authentication routes. Account and trusted-source failure throttles are transactionally shared across API instances, use HMAC identifiers, apply the greater schedule up to 32 seconds, and return generic failures.
claims.path_proved: The API integration ran the actual Fastify composition against app-role connections to an isolated disposable PostgreSQL database for temporary login, forced-change authorization, permanent password establishment, session revocation, fresh login, and shared throttle history across two Fastify instances. Repository integration assertions also cover expiry equality, logout/revocation, session rotation, throttle timing and bounded history.
